name: Inase Kohane
source:
A freshman student that tends to stand out for being a loner and wearing original school uniform that is no longer used. Most people believe her to be a delinquent so are afraid to interact with her. Is a round person that is athletic and when does try has above average grades.  


Likes: Peace and quiet
Dislikes: Interacting with others
Hobbies: Basking in the sun
